name: Gate the Hiss Between Notes
description: Synthesizes notes over a constant hiss and closes a noise gate in the gaps between them. Runs locally with no file, model or key.

data.comment:
# Gate the Hiss Between Notes

Synthesizes short notes over a constant hiss, then mutes the hiss in the gaps. Every step runs in the editor process, with no file, model or key.

**How it works:** "1 Notes" is a Code node that writes a note every 750 ms over hiss at about -45 dB. "2 Gate" closes when the level falls under -35 dB. "Dry level" passes the notes to "Before" at 0 dB. Compare "Before" with "After".

**Try this:** Set Threshold dB on "2 Gate" to -50 to keep the hiss, or set Release ms to 200 to hear the hiss fade out after each note.
